heading.title: Your natal chart, decoded
heading.subtitle: Enter your birth date and approximate time to reveal your core placements — Sun, Moon, and Rising — plus how this week's live transits aspect your chart.

signTraits.Aries: Bold, pioneering, and driven by impulse. You initiate before others have finished thinking.
signTraits.Taurus: Steady, sensual, and rooted. You build slowly and refuse to be rushed.
signTraits.Gemini: Quick, curious, and multilingual. You translate between worlds.
signTraits.Cancer: Tender, protective, and lunar. You feel the tide before it arrives.
signTraits.Leo: Radiant, generous, and dramatic. You lead with the heart exposed.
signTraits.Virgo: Precise, devoted, and refining. You find the sacred in the detail.
signTraits.Libra: Graceful, diplomatic, and relational. You weigh every angle before choosing.
signTraits.Scorpio: Intense, magnetic, and transformative. You descend to rise.
signTraits.Sagittarius: Expansive, honest, and seeking. You chase the horizon.
signTraits.Capricorn: Disciplined, ambitious, and enduring. You build mountains from patience.
signTraits.Aquarius: Visionary, detached, and electric. You see the future first.
signTraits.Pisces: Mystical, porous, and compassionate. You dissolve boundaries.

Aries.reading: Creative fire flows effortlessly — a window of bold self-expression.
Tension between your drive and partnership needs — channel into collaborative action.
Expansion through creative risk-taking this week.
A subtle pressure to integrate spiritual lessons into your daily routine.
Emotional friction between independence and domestic harmony.
Mental clarity supports practical planning — organize the details.
Unexpected insights arrive through conversation and curiosity.
A dreamy dissolution of old identity — let the mist clear before deciding.

Taurus.reading: Gentle emotional harmony — a good week for nurturing connections.
Discipline meets imagination — build something lasting from a vision.
Adjust your pace — rushing disrupts your natural rhythm.
Creative pressure to grow — say yes to the spotlight, even if it feels uncomfortable.
Unexpected financial or value shifts — stay flexible.
Earth-sign clarity — perfect for detailed planning and health routines.
A spiritual restlessness — ground through body-based practices.
Dramatic energy demands your attention — find your own stage.

Gemini.reading: Mental tension between big ideas and nitpicky details — slow down.
A lightning-bolt awakening — your mind is rewiring itself.
Communication opens doors — speak your vision loudly.
Air-sign harmony — your words carry grace and momentum.
Emotional conversations may feel heavy — listen before responding.
Structure meets confusion — anchor your ideas in a concrete plan.
Inspiration flows through writing and learning.
Adjust your creative output to match the audience.

Cancer.reading: Love and self-worth align — receive the affection coming your way.
Emotional maturity deepens — old fears soften into wisdom.
Home versus partnership tension — create space for both.
Growth demands visibility — step out of your shell.
Practical emotional intelligence — express feelings with precision.
Shift from nurturing to self-expression — both matter.
Intuitive flashes arrive through quiet reflection.
Emotional boundaries blur — protect your energy.

Leo.reading: Solar return season — your power is at its peak. Set intentions boldly.
Major expansion — abundance, creativity, and visibility multiply.
Diplomatic friction — your directness meets others' need for tact.
Adjust between public and private love — both need tending.
Spiritual responsibility calls — integrate the unseen.
Refine your message — precision amplifies your roar.
Innovative ideas arrive through your network.
Creative vision sharpens — trust the muse.

Virgo.reading: Mental mastery at its peak — analyze, organize, and refine.
Emotional flow supports your routines — weave love into the daily.
Graceful action — partnerships move forward with ease.
Adjust between detailed work and big-picture confidence.
Tension between precision and surrender — find the middle path.
Shift from behind-the-scenes to center stage.

Libra.reading: Action meets beauty — assert yourself with grace.
Tension between harmony and emotional depth — lean into honesty.
Refined communication — your words carry healing precision.
Social expansion — your network opens new doors.
Structure your dreams — don't let them stay abstract.
Balance your light with others' — collaboration fuels growth.
Identity versus illusion — clarify your boundaries.

Scorpio.reading: Power dynamics surface — transform tension into deeper intimacy.
Deep emotional waters flow — vulnerability becomes strength.
Spiritual discipline — old patterns release with grace.
Intensity meets visibility — let yourself be seen.
Mental analysis meets emotional depth — integrate both.
Power struggles between ego and soul — choose truth.

Sagittarius.reading: Fire-sign expansion — luck, travel, and learning align.
Diplomatic momentum — your enthusiasm meets graceful action.
Adjust between adventure and emotional security.
Structure your vision — discipline turns dreams into reality.
Big ideas meet detailed execution — bridge the gap.
Spiritual pioneering — trust the unknown path.

Capricorn.reading: Discipline meets compassion — build something that serves others.
Tension between ambition and partnership — negotiate carefully.
Work-life balance tested — honor both career and heart.
Growth through creative risk — step beyond the safe plan.
Adjust between steady progress and bold self-expression.
Innovative routines — upgrade your daily systems.
Spiritual discipline — structure your inner life.

Aquarius.reading: Air-sign revolution — breakthroughs arrive through ideas and networks.
Social action — your ideals meet graceful execution.
Adjust between collective vision and personal intimacy.
Tension between individuality and group dynamics — find your role.
Structure your vision — discipline grounds your ideals.
Bridge abstract thinking with practical detail.
Ego versus collective — honor both your light and the group.
Identity dissolution — let the old self dissolve.

Pisces.reading: A defining transit — structure your dreams, face your fears, mature spiritually.
Action meets dreaminess — ground your ideals in movement.
Growth through creative service — share your gifts.
Dream logic meets practical analysis — honor both.
Adjust between mystical and expressive modes.
Mental restlessness — ground through breath and routine.
Spiritual rebirth — a new cycle of compassion begins.
